description: This file defines a Java interface named ClientService, which declares methods for managing Client objects including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion. It also includes exception handling for SnowmanException.

classes.name: ClientService
classes.description: A Java interface that specifies operations related to Client management within the domain service layer.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object by its unique identifier.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new Client, throwing SnowmanException if creation fails.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing Client, throwing SnowmanException if the update fails.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a Client by its ID, throwing SnowmanException if deletion fails.
